stations.title: fleet.js
stations.text: A typed list. Only you can edit it.
stations.note: Every change is a request to you.

captions: Quotes work. Now Bram at the dock wants to add Kestrel, a new single.
The fleet is a typed list, so every change waits for you to edit a file.
You write a boat store and the routes around it, in three tasks.
Now Bram adds Kestrel himself, and can change or retire any boat.
Same boat, no file edits. The fleet is a resource now.
